description: A Free International Online Cybersecurity Capture The Flag Competition BlackPanda Labs Foundation, an India-based Section 8 nonprofit dedicated to practical cybersecurity education, invites students, cybersecurity enthusiasts, and security practitioners worldwide to participate in BlackPanda Labs CTF 2026. Event Details Date: Sunday, 20 December 2026 Mode: 100% Online Participation: Individual or team-based Registration Fee: Free Eligibility: Open to cybersecurity learners, students, and professionals worldwide Challenge Categories Web Application Pentesting API Pentesting Network Pentesting Digital Forensics Reverse Engineering Cryptography OSINT Miscellaneous Security Challenges Competition Format Participants will solve cybersecurity challenges, recover flags, and submit them through the competition platform to earn points. Challenges will vary in difficulty and reward practical problem-solving, technical analysis, and cybersecurity knowledge. Rankings will be determined by the competition's official scoring and tie-breaking rules, which will be communicated before the event. Prizes First Place: One ThunderCipher TC-VAPT certification exam voucher, subject to final allocation and redemption terms. First Place: 12 months total HackerDNA Pro access, divided equally among members if a team wins. Additional Rewards: Further educational sponsorships are being finalized and will be announced only when confirmed. Rules and Fair Play Participants must work only within authorized competition environments and provided challenge materials. Attacking the competition infrastructure, organizers, other participants, or external systems is prohibited. Flag sharing between competing teams or participants is prohibited. Automated activity must comply with competition-specific rules and platform restrictions. Final participation requirements, team limits, and detailed event rules will be published before the competition.

raw.details:
A Free International Online Cybersecurity Capture The Flag Competition

BlackPanda Labs Foundation, an India-based Section 8 nonprofit dedicated to practical cybersecurity education, invites students, cybersecurity enthusiasts, and security practitioners worldwide to participate in BlackPanda Labs CTF 2026.

Event Details

  • Date: Sunday, 20 December 2026
  • Mode: 100% Online
  • Participation: Individual or team-based
  • Registration Fee: Free
  • Eligibility: Open to cybersecurity learners, students, and professionals worldwide

Challenge Categories

  • Web Application Pentesting
  • API Pentesting
  • Network Pentesting
  • Digital Forensics
  • Reverse Engineering
  • Cryptography
  • OSINT
  • Miscellaneous Security Challenges

Competition Format

Participants will solve cybersecurity challenges, recover flags, and submit them through the competition platform to earn points.

Challenges will vary in difficulty and reward practical problem-solving, technical analysis, and cybersecurity knowledge.

Rankings will be determined by the competition's official scoring and tie-breaking rules, which will be communicated before the event.

Prizes

  • First Place: One ThunderCipher TC-VAPT certification exam voucher, subject to final allocation and redemption terms.
  • First Place: 12 months total HackerDNA Pro access, divided equally among members if a team wins.
  • Additional Rewards: Further educational sponsorships are being finalized and will be announced only when confirmed.

Rules and Fair Play

  • Participants must work only within authorized competition environments and provided challenge materials.
  • Attacking the competition infrastructure, organizers, other participants, or external systems is prohibited.
  • Flag sharing between competing teams or participants is prohibited.
  • Automated activity must comply with competition-specific rules and platform restrictions.
  • Final participation requirements, team limits, and detailed event rules will be published before the competition.
